messages.subject: TPC Power | Renewable power, sustainability and community stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear TPC Power Holding Leadership Team,

TPC Power's renewable-power and sustainability platform aligns closely with my experience across energy transition, community engagement and regulatory execution.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

My recent work includes governance around large-scale solar and battery storage, carbon-data readiness and community-sensitive operating matters. I bring practical experience connecting renewable projects with regulators, local stakeholders and accountable internal delivery.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand roles across Sustainability, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, Strategic Partnerships or renewable-project stakeholder leadership. I have attached a TPC Power-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
